posts.title: Knowing How Is Not Knowing What
posts.description: What RL environments need to supply: organizational context, domain rules and connected information.

posts.title: The Chameleon’s Limit: Why LLM Persona Populations Collapse
posts.description: A summary of our preprint. We measure persona collapse across 10 LLMs and 1,144 personas, and show that better per-persona fidelity often makes population diversity worse.

posts.title: AI Welfare Is Bullshit: Why Co-Engineered Metrics Cannot Govern Machine Suffering
posts.description: A summary of our position paper. We argue AI welfare assessment fails for two structural reasons: indicators are co-engineered with the systems they evaluate, and there is no external validation channel that can falsify them.
